PRIVACY & SOURCES

A small site, with clear boundaries

An independent notebook without advertising analytics or private bot records.

Public content and sources

Project notes and venue facts are public. Original names and recommendation links are preserved. Check sources before travelling; acknowledgements are collected on About.

Private records stay separate

The site never reads bot contacts, profiles, weather bindings, chats, screenshots or sticker databases, and does not connect to a home computer.

Browser and maps

Theme and language preferences may be saved in your browser. No geolocation is requested. Maps load only on request; Amap or OpenStreetMap then receive normal network information such as IP addresses. The list works without map tiles.

Owner editing

The studio uses a server-verified password and a secure HTTPOnly session cookie valid for one hour. There are no visitor accounts. Drafts remain in browser memory unless exported. Saving sends a selected public document to GitHub, followed by a separate build and deployment. Never add secrets or private records to public content. Credentials stay in server runtime secrets.

Corrections

Hosting services and GitHub may process operational logs under their own policies. For corrections or removal, open a repository issue without sensitive information.

Back to the notebook ←

Loading Amap contacts Amap servers; the security code stays on the server. OpenStreetMap remains an optional alternative.
